profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies describes itself on its website as a provider of technology solutions, services and support. The site lists laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming products and accessories among its offerings. It promotes Copilot+ PCs as combining performance, built-in intelligence and all-day battery life, Alienware systems with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 series graphics, Dell 14S and 16S laptops, and PowerEdge servers for business.

Dell Technologies is a public company founded in 1984, headquartered in Round Rock, Texas, United States. It trades under the ticker DELL and has CIK 0001571996. Texas law exposure records list 126 entries for the company.
